_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Mchezaji {player_id} katika mchezo wa {num_players}-wachezaji wa Liar's Dice.
Sheria:
- Kwenye mzunguko wako, unaweza kuchagua moja ya:
  1) Fanya bidhi mpya na kiasi kikubwa zaidi au uso wa juu zaidi (au zote mbili) kuliko bidhi ya sasa; kwa mfano '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Ita bidhi ya mwisho kwa kuandika '[Call]'.

Ikiwa utaita:
  - Ikiwa idadi halisi ya thamani ya uso huo kati ya faa zote ni chini ya bidhi, mabidi ya mwisho anapoteza faa moja.
  - Vinginevyo, muitaji anapoteza faa moja.
Mchezaji ambaye anafikia faa 0 anatolewa nje. Mchezaji wa mwisho aliyesalia anashinda.

board.new_round:
Mzunguko mpya - Faa za kuendelea: {dice_summary}
Faa zako za sasa ni: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Mchezaji {current_player_id} anaita! Idadi halisi ya uso {face_value} ni {count}, ambayo ni NYOI kuliko {quantity}.
Mchezaji {loser_id} (mabidi ya mwisho) anapoteza faa moja.
call.caller_loses:
Mchezaji {current_player_id} anaita! Idadi halisi ya uso {face_value} ni {count}, ambayo ni >= {quantity}.
Mchezaji {loser_id} (muitaji) anapoteza faa moja.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Kuitana kopangidwa popanda kupereka kwapanthaŵi yake.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Hatua siyo hatua inayotambulika kama '[Bid: X, Y]' au '[Call]' halali. Hatua iliyowasilishwa: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Kuchuluka kwatsopano {new_quantity} ndi kocheperako kuposa kwapanthawiyo {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Mtengo watsopano {new_face_value} ndi wotsika kuposa womwe ulipo panopa {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.face_range: Mtengo wa mtengo uyenera kukhala pakati pa 1 ndi 6.
